summary_bullets: Added a repo-wide Bash linter that rejects inline gh --body and --notes usage in shell and Python files while excluding file-backed variants and larch-logs artifacts.
Added a regression harness covering shell, heredoc, Python argv-list, suppression, non-git fallback, and tracked larch-logs cases.
Wired the lint into pre-commit, Makefile, harness shard coverage, linting docs, and agent-lint reachability exclusions.
commit_message:
lint: reject inline gh body payloads

Add a repo-wide pre-commit lint for inline gh --body and --notes usage, document the contract, and cover shell/Python argv-list cases plus larch-logs exclusion in the regression harness.
todos_left: Investigate existing test-apply-bump breadcrumb assertions; full make lint currently fails there before reaching the new shard entry.
